chunks: To those who desire the life of this world and its many allures, We shall pay them in full for their acts herein and will not withhold anything.

key_terms.لَا يُبْخَسُونَ: they will not be deprived/withheld from

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the reward of disbelievers and believers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the 'exhaustion' (istifraagh) of rewards for those who prioritize worldly allure over spiritual growth, ensuring they receive full credit for their deeds in this life so they enter the Hereafter with no good deeds left. This concept underscores the transient nature of dunya as a place of consumption rather than accumulation for the disbelievers, contrasting with the eternal growth of the faithful. The verse serves as a warning that worldly success for the unrighteous is not a sign of divine favor but a mechanism to settle their accounts completely.
